I’ve been taking my dog here for the last 11 years when Dr. Diaz was his main vet, he was wonderful. Honest and transparent, always warm and caring. Since his departure over the years I’ve noticed a lot of service slip ups and just general decline the staff. The vet tech  who last saw my dog didn’t even seem to have basic understanding of questions I asked so he just told me to ask the vet when she came into the room, which I did and even she was vague and with awkward energy. Not the warm or comforting type of interaction we used to get. Of course she and the tech just upsold me on a ton of vaccine combos which I normally have declined before, but since my dog is nearly 12 they stressed how it’s so important to get them annually. So I did this time - paid over $600 for the visit and vaccinations and was told to come back in 2 weeks for a booster of one of vaccines and to submit a urine sample. A quick routine follow up, sounded fine. Today we show up at our 4pm appointment for the booster and we’re finished by 4:15 and the receptionist hands me a bill for  $102. Like what??? No one AT ALL at any point mentioned I will be required to pay AGAIN for the vaccine (which he didn’t even need) and 2nd visit that was less than 15 min. Even charged me $10 for the urine same from my dog. Like wow what type of veterinary practice drops bills like this one people with no explanation? The receptionist with an attitude could only tell me “they should have explained to you” - yea, no shit. This place has obviously lost its moral purpose and is just a money grabbing operation with subpar vets and staff. What a shame!  Sadly I can’t recommend this place to anyone anymore bc without Dr. Diaz on staff this place is just not worth coming back to there are much better vets in the area.

I had been a client at this practice years ago and had a prescription for my senior cat's specialty food linked to my Chewy account. The food continued to arrive monthly on autoship for years, so I had no reason to believe there was an issue with the prescription.
When the food suddenly stopped arriving, I called the office multiple times over the course of a week, leaving several messages explaining that my 19-year-old cat was out of her specialty food. No one returned my calls.
When I finally reached someone, instead of offering help, I was met with a rude and accusatory tone. The staff member claimed they had called me in 2014 to request an appointment to renew the prescription, yet the prescription clearly remained active on my account for the past 11 years after that supposed call. When I asked if they could renew the prescription one final time while I transferred care to my new vet - explaining that abruptly switching food could make my elderly cat sick - she refused to even ask a veterinarian and accused me of negligence for not taking my cat to the vet. Of course I have taken my cat to a vet, just not that one.
For a practice that works with animals, the lack of compassion was shocking. My new vet was able to rush the prescription without an appointment because they understood the health implications for a senior cat.
I would not recommend this clinic to anyone who expects basic communication and courtesy.
